These days, I'm thinking the best way to protect my cartilage is to avoid wearing it down. Washing dishes was painful and frustrating, so I bought a mini dishwasher as a last resort. While it has its limitations, I'm satisfied. If you're reading reviews, I urge you to buy it now. I've been using it for over three weeks now, and I've switched between Ever Zero tablet detergent and Super Bubble liquid detergent. At first, I was worried that the detergent might stain the dish, but I divided it into 12 portions instead of 4, and it didn't leave any marks and the dishes washed cleanly. I chop it up finely and adjust it according to the amount of dishes I use. The liquid detergent is supposed to be used for 6 people, so I put it in a plastic bottle for children and squeezed out about 3ml at a time, and the dishes were washed cleanly. Don't buy conditioner. I ordered it when I bought it, but I returned it. The Minix dishwasher doesn't have a separate detergent compartment; it sits on the bottom, so you can't use conditioner. That's why you should use one of the new all-in-one products. I bought the conditioner because I heard it was good for removing stains, but I canceled it, but the silicone lid stains no matter what detergent I use. Glass containers and stainless steel pots are cleaned sparklingly, just like with detergent. The cutlery holder can be stacked on two levels, and you can put spoons and cooking utensils on top. After using it for a few days, it felt a little uncomfortable, and when I stacked them on top, there were parts where the water didn't flow, so I bought an LG dishwasher cutlery holder and inserted it in the middle, and it somehow fits securely. If the back part is not stacked correctly, it can fall down and the rotating blades underneath can't turn, but since there's a middle support, it's easy to stack and it feels like it can hold more. I think there's a little misunderstanding about the door opening part! I naturally thought the door would open automatically after washing and drying with hot air. However, when I wash it normally, it washes for 1 hour and dries for 2 hours. After washing for 1 hour, it opens, waits for a few minutes, then closes again to dry for 2 hours. And the door doesn't open automatically again! So when I turn it on before work, I either press the storage button to wash it and leave, or when the 1-hour wash is done, I turn it off and leave the door wide open. If I just close the door after washing, the window gets humid. So I use tweezers to keep it from closing completely. The interior light turns off after a few minutes, but the front window's open button doesn't turn off. So, I ordered a single-outlet outlet. I want to be able to immediately turn off the power without unplugging the cord when I'm done washing. When I first received the product, the box was tattered, so I was worried it might be a return. There were also scratches on the water tank, which I was concerned might break it, and there was water inside the product, so I called customer service. They told me that, while not all products are like this, they do have a label stating that they test the product before shipping to prevent malfunctions. They also said the water tank couldn't be exchanged separately, so I decided to just use it. The box was so huge that I couldn't even think about exchanging it. It's supposed to be quiet, but it's not unbearably loud, either. It's as noisy as a mini washing machine or spin dryer running inside the house. I've attached a video so you can listen. I can hear the noise coming from the front door. I saw on YouTube that they recommend stacking dishes and turning the top and bottom spinning plates to see if they're spinning. Since it is a transparent window, you need to check if the water stream is spinning and spraying in the middle. Sometimes, the water stream gets stuck in the gap below and doesn't go back, and there were a few times when the upper water stream turning plate was fixed even though there was definitely nothing blocking it, so I stopped it and tried spinning it again by hand and pressed the wash button again, and it worked fine that time. I think you need to check once in a while if the water stream is spraying properly. And the color is a modern gray,,,, but maybe because I am old-fashioned, I think white like the water purifier next to it would be better. Comments (English): [ For my wrists and finger joints ] || ---------------- || My husband asked me if I was using a mini dishwasher. I was so touched that I exclaimed, "Even a cat's paw would be so helpful, but this dishwasher and the robot vacuum are the only things that care for me in this house!" Sometimes, I'd stack the dishes to ensure even water flow, and then, as time flew by, I'd think I'd already finished washing them, and then I'd get a realization: time had passed, but my wrists and knuckles hadn't been used as much. I'd say I'd only washed a few dishes, but my finger joints were aching, and my wrists were starting to feel worse. These days, I'm thinking the best way to protect my cartilage is to avoid wearing it down. Washing dishes was painful and frustrating, so I bought a mini dishwasher as a last resort. While it has its limitations, I'm satisfied. If you're reading reviews, I urge you to buy it now. I've been using it for over three weeks now, and I've switched between Ever Zero tablet detergent and Super Bubble liquid detergent. At first, I was worried that the detergent might stain the dish, but I divided it into 12 portions instead of 4, and it didn't leave any marks and the dishes washed cleanly. I chop it up finely and adjust it according to the amount of dishes I use. The liquid detergent is supposed to be used for 6 people, so I put it in a plastic bottle for children and squeezed out about 3ml at a time, and the dishes were washed cleanly. Don't buy conditioner. I ordered it when I bought it, but I returned it. The Minix dishwasher doesn't have a separate detergent compartment; it sits on the bottom, so you can't use conditioner. That's why you should use one of the new all-in-one products. I bought the conditioner because I heard it was good for removing stains, but I canceled it, but the silicone lid stains no matter what detergent I use. Glass containers and stainless steel pots are cleaned sparklingly, just like with detergent. The cutlery holder can be stacked on two levels, and you can put spoons and cooking utensils on top. After using it for a few days, it felt a little uncomfortable, and when I stacked them on top, there were parts where the water didn't flow, so I bought an LG dishwasher cutlery holder and inserted it in the middle, and it somehow fits securely. If the back part is not stacked correctly, it can fall down and the rotating blades underneath can't turn, but since there's a middle support, it's easy to stack and it feels like it can hold more. I think there's a little misunderstanding about the door opening part! I naturally thought the door would open automatically after washing and drying with hot air. However, when I wash it normally, it washes for 1 hour and dries for 2 hours. After washing for 1 hour, it opens, waits for a few minutes, then closes again to dry for 2 hours. And the door doesn't open automatically again! So when I turn it on before work, I either press the storage button to wash it and leave, or when the 1-hour wash is done, I turn it off and leave the door wide open. If I just close the door after washing, the window gets humid. So I use tweezers to keep it from closing completely. The interior light turns off after a few minutes, but the front window's open button doesn't turn off. So, I ordered a single-outlet outlet. I want to be able to immediately turn off the power without unplugging the cord when I'm done washing. When I first received the product, the box was tattered, so I was worried it might be a return. There were also scratches on the water tank, which I was concerned might break it, and there was water inside the product, so I called customer service. They told me that, while not all products are like this, they do have a label stating that they test the product before shipping to prevent malfunctions. They also said the water tank couldn't be exchanged separately, so I decided to just use it. The box was so huge that I couldn't even think about exchanging it. It's supposed to be quiet, but it's not unbearably loud, either. It's as noisy as a mini washing machine or spin dryer running inside the house. I've attached a video so you can listen. I can hear the noise coming from the front door. I saw on YouTube that they recommend stacking dishes and turning the top and bottom spinning plates to see if they're spinning. Since it is a transparent window, you need to check if the water stream is spinning and spraying in the middle. Sometimes, the water stream gets stuck in the gap below and doesn't go back, and there were a few times when the upper water stream turning plate was fixed even though there was definitely nothing blocking it, so I stopped it and tried spinning it again by hand and pressed the wash button again, and it worked fine that time. I think you need to check once in a while if the water stream is spraying properly. And the color is a modern gray,,,, but maybe because I am old-fashioned, I think white like the water purifier next to it would be better. I chop it up finely and adjust it according to the amount of dishes I use. That's why you should use one of the new all-in-one products. After using it for a few days, it felt a little uncomfortable, and when I stacked them on top, there were parts where the water didn't flow, so I bought an LG dishwasher cutlery holder and inserted it in the middle, and it somehow fits securely. If the back part is not stacked correctly, it can fall down and the rotating blades underneath can't turn, but since there's a middle support, it's easy to stack and it feels like it can hold more. I think there's a little misunderstanding about the door opening part! I naturally thought the door would open automatically after washing and drying with hot air. However, when I wash it normally, it washes for 1 hour and dries for 2 hours. After washing for 1 hour, it opens, waits for a few minutes, then closes again to dry for 2 hours. And the door doesn't open automatically again! So when I turn it on before work, I either press the storage button to wash it and leave, or when the 1-hour wash is done, I turn it off and leave the door wide open. If I just close the door after washing, the window gets humid. So I use tweezers to keep it from closing completely. The interior light turns off after a few minutes, but the front window's open button doesn't turn off. So, I ordered a single-outlet outlet. I want to be able to immediately turn off the power without unplugging the cord when I'm done washing. When I first received the product, the box was tattered, so I was worried it might be a return. There were also scratches on the water tank, which I was concerned might break it, and there was water inside the product, so I called customer service. They told me that, while not all products are like this, they do have a label stating that they test the product before shipping to prevent malfunctions. They also said the water tank couldn't be exchanged separately, so I decided to just use it. The box was so huge that I couldn't even think about exchanging it. It's supposed to be quiet, but it's not unbearably loud, either. It's as noisy as a mini washing machine or spin dryer running inside the house. I've attached a video so you can listen. I can hear the noise coming from the front door. I saw on YouTube that they recommend stacking dishes and turning the top and bottom spinning plates to see if they're spinning. Since it is a transparent window, you need to check if the water stream is spinning and spraying in the middle. I think you need to check once in a while if the water stream is spraying properly. While it has its limitations, I'm satisfied. If you're reading reviews, I urge you to buy it now. I've been using it for over three weeks now, and I've switched between Ever Zero tablet detergent and Super Bubble liquid detergent. At first, I was worried that the detergent might stain the dish, but I divided it into 12 portions instead of 4, and it didn't leave any marks and the dishes washed cleanly. I chop it up finely and adjust it according to the amount of dishes I use. The liquid detergent is supposed to be used for 6 people, so I put it in a plastic bottle for children and squeezed out about 3ml at a time, and the dishes were washed cleanly. Don't buy conditioner. I ordered it when I bought it, but I returned it. The Minix dishwasher doesn't have a separate detergent compartment; it sits on the bottom, so you can't use conditioner. That's why you should use one of the new all-in-one products. I bought the conditioner because I heard it was good for removing stains, but I canceled it, but the silicone lid stains no matter what detergent I use. Glass containers and stainless steel pots are cleaned sparklingly, just like with detergent. The cutlery holder can be stacked on two levels, and you can put spoons and cooking utensils on top. After using it for a few days, it felt a little uncomfortable, and when I stacked them on top, there were parts where the water didn't flow, so I bought an LG dishwasher cutlery holder and inserted it in the middle, and it somehow fits securely. If the back part is not stacked correctly, it can fall down and the rotating blades underneath can't turn, but since there's a middle support, it's easy to stack and it feels like it can hold more. I think there's a little misunderstanding about the door opening part! I naturally thought the door would open automatically after washing and drying with hot air. However, when I wash it normally, it washes for 1 hour and dries for 2 hours. After washing for 1 hour, it opens, waits for a few minutes, then closes again to dry for 2 hours. And the door doesn't open automatically again! So when I turn it on before work, I either press the storage button to wash it and leave, or when the 1-hour wash is done, I turn it off and leave the door wide open. If I just close the door after washing, the window gets humid. So I use tweezers to keep it from closing completely. The interior light turns off after a few minutes, but the front window's open button doesn't turn off. So, I ordered a single-outlet outlet. I want to be able to immediately turn off the power without unplugging the cord when I'm done washing. When I first received the product, the box was tattered, so I was worried it might be a return. There were also scratches on the water tank, which I was concerned might break it, and there was water inside the product, so I called customer service. They told me that, while not all products are like this, they do have a label stating that they test the product before shipping to prevent malfunctions. They also said the water tank couldn't be exchanged separately, so I decided to just use it. The box was so huge that I couldn't even think about exchanging it. It's supposed to be quiet, but it's not unbearably loud, either. It's as noisy as a mini washing machine or spin dryer running inside the house. I've attached a video so you can listen. I can hear the noise coming from the front door. I saw on YouTube that they recommend stacking dishes and turning the top and bottom spinning plates to see if they're spinning. Since it is a transparent window, you need to check if the water stream is spinning and spraying in the middle. Sometimes, the water stream gets stuck in the gap below and doesn't go back, and there were a few times when the upper water stream turning plate was fixed even though there was definitely nothing blocking it, so I stopped it and tried spinning it again by hand and pressed the wash button again, and it worked fine that time. I think you need to check once in a while if the water stream is spraying properly. Comments (English): [ Outstaning Cleaning, Good Combination of Features ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher replaced a 24-yr-old Bosch, a swap heavily encouraged by an outstanding sale price offered by Costco. The old Bosch still ran fine but it never was able to deliver dry plastics and at that age I figured it was only a matter of time before something broke. This model LG is no longer being made but they are still available on the LG website as well as Costco and other retail outlets. I feel fortunate to have snagged one as its complement of features is no longer available in the top-line LG-branded machines. While they have the true-steam and quad-wash they no longer offer the interior LED lights outside of their top-line Signature model. The LDT7808SS has the cheery and useful interior lights that activate when the door of the machine is opened. I very much appreciate this feature. Top features: Incredibly clean dishes Very good drying with the longer cycles Racks are super flexible. The top silver rack offers a drop-down tray for larger items such as ladles and spatulas. and both upper racks glide in and out on ball bearings. I especially like the setup with the middle rack which can be raised and lowered instantly simply by pressing a pair of buttons and lifting or lowering it to where you need it for the particular load. I also especially like the fact that I do not even need to use the silverware basket. One is included with the machine but is not necessary with the third rack in place. There is no end to my delight in being able to fit multiple pots and skillets into a rack without having to dodge a silverware basket. A couple of detractions with the dishwasher are the long cycle times. Selecting steam and heated dry sets you up for a 3-hour run time. Fortunately there is an express wash feature that finishes in 34 minutes for lightly soiled loads and a turbo wash for for baked-on food that finishes in an hour. Neither of these cycles dries the load but at least you can get multiple loads through the machine in a reasonable time even if having to dry manually. The other gripe is the machine is not as silent as the ads would have you believe. No, it is not noisy by any means and it does not interrupt kitchen conversations or living-room TV watching but you *can hear it running. I was expecting it to be a bit quieter.

Sentence (English): I have had this for over a month and few things I would change about the dishwasher and the process.
Comments (English): [ Very quiet with a few quirks ] || ---------------- || I have had this for over a month and few things I would change about the dishwasher and the process. First, I was replacing a 20-year old GE dishwasher that is built like a tank. It still worked, but never really dried the dishes well. This one was reviewed by Consumer Reports and did well, so we gave it a try. So, here are the highlights, if you are replacing an older dishwasher, you may need a new electrical box to connect it to your house. The installer had one, but it was an additional $100 on the spot, so add that to the cost. Second, my biggest complaint is that the door feels very flimsy and twists slightly when open and closing it. Third, there is no way to warn someone if you just washed dished or only used the rinse cycle. If someone opens it after the 9-minute rinse cycle they could potentially think the dishes were cleaned and try to put them away. I will probably add a "dirty/clean" magnet for others in the house to be aware of this, but that takes away from the clean aesthetic of the front. Fourth, the top rack gets really hot and has melted the coating off of some KitchenAid knives, so be careful. Lastly, the dryer seems to get things really dry about 50% of the time, so additional drying may still be needed especially on plastic items. As for the good, it cleans very, very well even though the cycle time is typically 2 hours. It is extremely quiet--I mean "really" quiet-- and it shows a solid red light on the floor when it's running so you can see that it's on at a glance. Its modular design is great for different sized items from pots and pans to small silverware. Overall, it is very easy to use even though 90% of the time I just use "Auto". Even with its faults, it's miles ahead of my old dishwasher. I would definitely buy it again just for the quiet operation. Did I mention it was quiet?

Sentence (English): Having owned dishwashers for most of my life, I was really looking forward to finally having my own Bosch.
Comments (English): [ Fabulous dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Having owned dishwashers for most of my life, I was really looking forward to finally having my own Bosch. If you're like me, having a dishwasher still means pre-washing dishes or suffering from the heat-dried remains of last night's dinner on plates, pans, and bowls. With Bosch, it's time to break the habit, save some water and let the appliance do the work. After all, you don't pre-wash your clothes by hand and then throw them in the washing machine; The washing machine is simply left to do what it was designed to do. This Bosch dishwasher is amazing! We tried it after a tomato- and cheese-heavy Italian meal, which is usually one of the trickiest messes to clean up. While I couldn't help but wipe off the worst of the grease and bolognese, I didn't rinse them and just put them on. An hour later, they came out of the machine shiny, smelling great and with no trace of red. sauce, grease or stuck to cheese! Put your energy and love into cooking and let your Bosch dishwasher take care of the cleaning. Oh, and did I mention I drove the cycle from the couch? Home Connect is wonderful. Totally recommended!

Después de todo, no se lava previamente la ropa a mano y luego se mete en la lavadora; simplemente se deja que la lavadora haga lo que fue diseñada para hacer. ¡Este lavavajillas Bosch es increíble! Lo probamos después de una comida italiana rica en tomate y queso, que normalmente es uno de los desastres más complicados de limpiar. Si bien no pude evitar limpiar lo peor de la grasa y la boloñesa, no los enjuagué y simplemente los puse. Pon tu energía y amor en cocinar y deja que tu lavavajillas Bosch se encargue de la limpieza. Ah, ¿y mencioné que manejé el ciclo desde el sofá? Home Connect es maravilloso. ¡Totalmente recomendado!

Comments (English): [ Great looking workhorse! ] || ---------------- || I've owned the dishwasher for a little over a month. It is quiet and does an excellent job cleaning dishes and cookware. The FreeFlex Third Rack works well for life in our home where we use more coffee mugs and glasses than we do flatware although the flatware basket is large enough to hold flatware for a larger family. We like that we're able to toss a detergent pod in the top rack or use the soap dispenser. KitchenAid did an excellent job in creating a series of dishwashers at various price points depending on the number of features. Even the less pricey models, like ours, seems to have top quality components. Our only disappointment: the interior racks are less accommodating overall than two previous dishwashers so it seems like we can get quite as much into the dishwasher, which results in more loads or washing some items by hand.

Sentence (English): We are a family of 4 that does lots of cooking and we run the dishwasher daily.
Comments (English): [ Best dishwasher I've ever owned ] || ---------------- || We are a family of 4 that does lots of cooking and we run the dishwasher daily. I have thrown everything I can at this machine and everything has come out clean. We scrape but never rinse. Gunk caked on pots. Crust in the corners of baking dishes. I've so far been unable to stump this dishwasher. I love the interior light, floor timer light, and water softener. The app lets you know when things are wrong (out of salt, out of rinse aid, something blocking the lower spin arm). Dishes come out sparkling clean and dry every time. And it's basically silent. This dishwasher is well worth the money. I have a few small gripes that are all related to the human interface team. A) The power button provides no visual, audio, or mechanical feedback until 1 to 2 seconds after you press it. That's just enough time to make me think I didn't press it correctly. But inevitably a 2nd press turns it back off. It's stupid. B) The app takes quite a bit of time to connect to the dishwasher and often it just will not connect at all. Sometimes turning on the dishwasher will help. Sometimes resetting the dishwasher will help. Other times I just give up. C) There is no delay start button on the dishwasher, you must use the app for that. The app has lots of time features: delay start, specific time start, and run during a specific time of day. But it's a pain to start my dishwasher via the app every single day. A normal delay button that cycles through some delay hours would be nice. D) A fully programable “custom” button on the dishwasher would be great. I almost always use the exact same settings for every load. But that includes a time-of-day range setting that can only be added via the app. I can program the app with a favorite cycle and time of day but I cannot link that to a button on the dishwasher. All of those gripes pale in comparison to how amazing the dishwasher is though. My dirty stuff comes out clean. Amazing!

Sentence (English): The SHP78CM5N washes dishes and glasses like a dream.
Comments (English): [ A great dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The SHP78CM5N washes dishes and glasses like a dream. I use Cascade soap and Finish rinse, resulting in gleaming dishes with no watermarks, streaks, or water left on my dishes. The plastic lids and containers are much dryer than they were in my older Bosch, but if the lid has any dip for water to collect, this Bosch doesn't dry it perfectly dry. Also, even though I don't hear any of the washing, I do hear my water pipes flowing, so the whole process is not perfectly quiet as I had expected. The capacity of the machine is very efficient, with the flexibility of the racks themselves, as well as the flexibility of the height of racks. The utensil rack was too small for the number of utensils that we use, not including the cooking utensils, which I place in the shallow top rack, but I just purchased the second utensil rack (along with the tall bottle, hooks, etc.), so I look forward to being able to separate my utensils before I wash them, so that the sorting at the end is minimal. I'd love for Bosch to be able to devise a way for a push button to pull out shelves.

Sentence (English): I bought Bosch only because of the quality.
Comments (English): [ Bosch DW Quality is dropping ] || ---------------- || I bought Bosch only because of the quality. Our previous model lasted 17 years and was still running well when we remodeled earlier this year. This is partially because my wife prewashes everything before it goes in the DW. We have been recommending Bosch to everyone for many years and telling everyone not to even bother considering any other brand. However, the new Bosch is nowhere near as good as they used to be. First, it is considerably noisier than the older model although spec wise it is supposed to be 3 dB lower (3 dB means it is supposed to be twice as quiet but in fact is noisier). Second, and most important, the soap pod dispenser fails to open or fails to open fully roughly every 3 to 4 cycles. The cycle ends and you realize the dishes are not cleaned and the soap dispenser is closed or only partially open with the soap partially there. So now you have to run the dishwasher again, wasting time, energy and water. This DW was supposed to save us water and energy but instead it is the exact opposite. I will try and replace the dispenser and maybe it is just one diffective unit rather than a bad flimsy design across the board. Time will tell. At this point, we stopped recommending Bosch till we confirm our experience is just an oddity. btw, our old Bosch diswasher also did that from time to time but it would only happen once a month at most, not every 3 or 4 cycles (and sometimes twice in a row).

We were very happy with it until it started leaking water from the icemaker around April or May of 2023. In addition, there was an error code that showed on the display, and when this showed, the panel was completely disabled. This meant no water as well. Very frustrating. I contacted customer service, and was told that this is a common issue (serious problem), and the way to fix it was to unplug the fridge, remove all food, and let the fridge defrost. This was infuriating, as it I have never experienced this with any other refrigerator, and this was a huge inconvenience to remove all food and move to the old fridge. Luckily, we retained the old fridge and was able to do this. Well, this solved the problem temporarily. Several months later the very same issue showed up again. The error message pops up intermittently and the dispensers and panel are inoperable for a few days until it decides to work again. Unfortunately, the fridge is now out of warranty, as it just expired in September of this year. Now we are stuck with an expensive fridge that doesn't work properly and we've only owned it for little over a year. Needless to say, we will never buy another LG refrigerator.E

Sentence (English): There weren't as many reviews as I expected, so I read each one carefully before buying.
Comments (English): [ It washes well and holds quite a lot! ] || ---------------- || There weren't as many reviews as I expected, so I read each one carefully before buying. It's for 6 people, but it's quite large. You need to check the detailed dimensions in advance. Since there's no depth measurement, I compared it with similar products and checked that it was 82cm when the lid was opened, and secured that size. My water purifier was replaced with a smaller one, so it was possible because there was still space left. And the installer was very good at finding the right location. Although it's for 6 people, it can accommodate a meal for a family of 4. It includes 7 cups, 4 cold noodle makers, 5 soup and rice bowls, 1 side dish container, 1 sauce bowl, and several spoons and spatulas. You can fit a little more there. It's only been two days since I used it, so I'm still practicing Tetris. I had curry today, and the cold noodle maker was very clean. Of course, I did some larvae. I gently shook the solids and any remaining residue under running warm water before putting it back in. For reference, I used the P7 automatic mode. I was a little worried because there was no automatic door opening, but I don't go out right after eating, doing the dishwasher, or anything like that, so I think it's okay. Given my family's lifestyle, I don't think there will be many cases where they run the dishwasher and then go out and there's no one home. (It would be even better if it was on rapid mode.) There were some articles saying that water would splash if you opened it right after washing, so I opened it after a while, and there was no splashing even if I opened it after 6, 5, or 1 minute. I didn't open it right after the beeping sound, but I think it would be fine as long as you don't open it too diligently. I tried the standard, rapid, and automatic wash modes, and they all washed well. I think I'll use rapid and automatic mainly. Rapid when there's not much dishware, and automatic is enough in the evening. It seems like 95% of the water gets dry when it comes out. The bottom of a concave bowl or cup? Except for the part, it's barely a drop or two. I only used 1/4 of a Prosh baking soda for the detergent. If there are water marks or an odor, you may want to adjust the amount of detergent. It's definitely convenient because it has a dishwasher. Even my mother, who used to say, "What's the use of a dishwasher if you're just using a rudimentary dishwasher," is satisfied. It really saves hands. I bought one for 6 people because there wasn't enough space, but next time I want to buy a bigger one so I can use it to do all the dishes, including the pot. I like it even more because I bought it on sale. I'm even happier that the price has gone up by 50,000 won now.
Comments (Original): [ 세척도 잘되고 꽤 많이 들어가요! ] || ---------------- || 생각보다 후기가 엄청 많지않아서 후기 하나하나 정독한 후에 샀어요.6인용이지만 꽤 큽니다. 상세사이즈 미리 확인이 필요합니다. 깊이 수치가 없어서 비슷한 다른 제품들 비교해서 뚜껑열었을 때 82센치로 체크했고 그 정도 확보해두었습니다. 저희집은 정수기를 작은 걸로 교체하고 자리가 남아서 가능했어요. 그리고 기사님이 좋은 위치 잘 잡아주세요. 6인용이지만 4인가구 한끼 식사는 모두 들어갈 수 있어요.컵7개 냉면기 4개 국그릇밥그릇5개 반찬통1개 소스그릇1개수저 주걱 여러개 . 저기에서 좀 더 들어갈 수 있어요. 쓴지 2일차라 ㅋㅋ 아직 테트리스 연습중이에요. 오늘은 카레 먹었는데 냉면기 세척수준 아주 좋습니다.물론 애벌은 했어요. 건더기랑 묻은 것은 흐르는 따뜻한 물에 슬슬 흔들어서 씻어내고 넣었어요. 참고로 p7 자동모드로 돌렸습니다. 자동문열림 없어서 조금 고민했는데 애초에 밥먹고 식세기 돌리고 바로 밖으로 나가거나 뭐 그럴일이 없어서 괜찮은 것 같아요.가족들 라이프 스타일 상 식세기 돌리고 외출해서 집에 사람이 1명도 없는 경우는 잘 없을것 같아요. (쾌속모드하면 더더욱 괜찮을듯) 세척 끝나고 바로 열면 물 튄다는 글도 있어서 시간차 두고 열었는데, 6분, 5분, 1분 정도 뒤에 열어도 튀는 것은 없었어요. 띠띠 소리나고 바로 열진 않았는데 그렇게 바지런하게 ㅋㅋ 열지만 않으면 될거 같아요.세척모드는 표준 쾌속 자동 모드 해봤는데 모두 잘세척됩니다.쾌속과 자동을 주로 쓸 것 같아요.식기가 적을 땐 쾌속, 저녁에는 자동이면 충분합니다.물끼는 95프로 말라서 나오는 것 같아요. 오목한 그릇이나 컵 뒷굽? 부분 제외하면 거의 한 두 방울 정도 묻어있는 수준입니다.세제는 프로쉬 베이킹소다 1/4 조각만 넣었어요.물자국 남거나 냄새나면 세제량을 조절해보셔도 좋을 것 같아요.식세기가 있으니 확실히 편리합니다.애벌하면 식세기 무슨 소용이냐 이랬던 어머니도 만족해 하세요.손이 정말 덜가거든요.자리가 안나와서 6인용 했는데 담에 큰거 사서 냄비까지 한꺼번에 돌리고 싶어요. 가격도 세일할때 사서 더더욱 마음에 듭니다. 지금 5만원이나 올라서 더 뿌듯하네요 ㅎㅎ

Sentence (English): We are a dual-income couple and have finally purchased the 14-person Samsung Bespoke dishwasher that we had been waiting to buy.
Comments (English): [ We are a dual-income couple and have been looking to buy a Samsung Bespoke dishwasher for 14 people. ] || ---------------- || We are a dual-income couple and have finally purchased the 14-person Samsung Bespoke dishwasher that we had been waiting to buy. I considered a 12-seater or a 14-seater, but decided on the 23-year-old model, which has a large capacity and good performance. After purchasing the product and entering the desired installation date, a sink reformer visited the day before installation to inspect and reform the product, and the next day, a dishwasher installer visited and completed the installation. After dinner, I put the dishes, plates, and spoons in the dishwasher and ran it in the standard + hot air dry mode. It cleaned well, but there was still a lot of moisture left in the dryer. Next time, I'll have to try the strong hot air drying function. I've used it once, but it seems to work well, and I like it because I chose a product color that matches my sink. The downside is that there is no general picnic function apart from the hot air function. If you have a regular picnic function, it would be easy to turn it on for about 20 minutes to circulate the air inside and let it dry naturally. I also cut the partition on the bottom skirting board when remodeling the sink, but after installing the product and finally checking it, I thought there was no need to cut it. It's a shame that the separation has occurred for some reason and it doesn't look good.
Comments (Original): [ 맞벌이 부부인데 그동안 구매하려고 찜해둔 삼성비스포크 식기세척기 14인... ] || ---------------- || 맞벌이 부부인데 그동안 구매하려고 찜해둔 삼성비스포크 식기세척기 14인용을 드디어 구매했어요. 12인용과 14인용을 고민했지만 용량크고 성능 좋은 23년 제품으로 결정했어요. 제품구입하고 설치희망일을 기입하니 설치 하루전날 싱크대리폼 기사님이 방문해서 설치점검 및 리폼을 진행해주셨고 다음날 식기세척기 설치기사님이 방문하셔서 설치완료 해주셨네요. 저녁 먹고 그릇과 접시, 수저 등을 식기세척기 넣고 표준+열풍건조 일반 모드로 돌려봤는데 세척은 잘되고 건조는 물기가 아직 많이 남아있네요.다음에는 강력 열풍건조 기능으로 해봐야겠네요.한번 사용해봤지만 성능은 좋은 것 같고 싱크대와 어울리는 제품 색상을 선택했기에 마음에 들어요~단점이라면 열풍기능과 별도로 일반 소풍기능이 없네요. 일반 소풍기능이 있으면 20분정도 돌려서 공기를 내부순환시켜 자연건조하기가 쉬울것 같네요. 그리고 싱크대 리폼하면서 하단 걸레받이 칸막이 부분을 절단했었는데 제품설치하고 최종적으로 확인하니 굳이 절단을 안해도 될 것 같다는 생각이 들었네요. 왠지 이격이 발생하여 보기가 안 좋아 아쉽네요.

Sentence (English): We needed to replace our dishwasher and were torn between buying just another dishwasher or splurging a little on something better.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher done right. ] || ---------------- || We needed to replace our dishwasher and were torn between buying just another dishwasher or splurging a little on something better. We decided to splurge a little and yet we could not decide between the Bosch 300 or 800 series. After some deliberation, we decide on the Bosch 800 Series (Model: SHP78CM5N) and we are quite pleased with our choice. It is a well built machine, beautiful to look at and most importantly it really works great. Not to mention it is absoluely the quietest dishwasher we have ever had. After its first use, it was very apparent just how lacking our old dishwasher was. Everything that goes in comes out sparkling clean and completely dry. We have found that the third rack (for silverware) takes some getting use to, but our silverware is definately coming out much cleaner. If you find yourself in need of a new dishwasher, we can honestly say that you cannot go wrong with the Bosch 800 Series. Now we just have to hope that its durable and gives us years of troble free service.

Sentence (English): I bought a Bosch on the recommendation of several people, and I don't see how it is any better than the other brand I replaced.
Comments (English): [ Not up to the hype ] || ---------------- || I bought a Bosch on the recommendation of several people, and I don't see how it is any better than the other brand I replaced. First, I had to use a power converter as the previous dishwasher was hardwired. The converter makes the dishwasher stick out from the cupboard by 1.5". It looks terrible. The door is hard to open, which would be difficult for the elderly and people with arthritis (like my mother demonstrated). The join between the control panel and the front of the door has a sharp lip, which I have scraped myself on when opening the door with the force required. The door also feels flimsy, so it twists if you don't pull it open from the centre. The configuration of the dishwasher racks makes loading awkward (I don't have odd-shaped dishes either). It does clean well, but still leaves some food behind. It is quiet and does a good job drying. I would have returned this if it hadn't taken three people to install in the first place, and who were too frustrated to repeat the process.

If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . Sentence (English): I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people.
Comments (English): [ This dishwasher has all the essential features at an affordable price. ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move. /People renting a house. /People looking to install it at their parents' house, where complex features aren't needed. /People with a small family. /People looking for a cost-effective product that delivers on basic functions. I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

Sentence (English): My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it.
Comments (English): [ This dishwasher has all the essential features at an affordable price. ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move. /People renting a house. /People looking to install it at their parents' house, where complex features aren't needed. /People with a small family. /People looking for a cost-effective product that delivers on basic functions. I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

Comments (English): [ This dishwasher has all the essential features at an affordable price. ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move. /People renting a house. /People looking to install it at their parents' house, where complex features aren't needed. /People with a small family. /People looking for a cost-effective product that delivers on basic functions. I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl.
