Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. Comments (English): [ This dishwasher has all the essential features at an affordable price. ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move. /People renting a house. /People looking to install it at their parents' house, where complex features aren't needed. /People with a small family. /People looking for a cost-effective product that delivers on basic functions. I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

Comments (English): [ This dishwasher has all the essential features at an affordable price. ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move. /People renting a house. /People looking to install it at their parents' house, where complex features aren't needed. /People with a small family. /People looking for a cost-effective product that delivers on basic functions. I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

Comments (English): [ This dishwasher has all the essential features at an affordable price. ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move. /People renting a house. /People looking to install it at their parents' house, where complex features aren't needed. /People with a small family. /People looking for a cost-effective product that delivers on basic functions. I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I'd highly recommend this Samsung dishwasher review to these people. I fall into the first category. I'm planning to move within the next year or two, if not immediately. My existing six-person dishwasher broke, so I had no choice but to buy it. I couldn't use it for long and had to leave it at my current home. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, but I chose this model for the following reasons: 1. Insane value for money. (I got it on a super, super hot deal. My purchase price was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. Low sink installation costs. (My sink was a non-standard cabinet, requiring me to reduce and reinforce the cabinet underneath the bowl. Installation costs varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. For standard cabinets, all brands offer free installation.) Product Name: Samsung Electronics Dishwasher Built-in Real Stainless Steel. Size. 12-seater. Color. Silver. Material. Stainless steel. Design. - Freestanding/built-in compatible. - Front button operation (touch X). - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment Yes). - Cutlery basket Yes. - Interior (tub) material: stainless steel. - Butyl soundproofing (no asphalt X). Functions. - Automatic door opening Yes. - Powerful drying Yes (no hot air drying No). - Reservation function Yes. - Additional rinse Yes. - Sterilization function Yes. - Steam soak Yes. - Internal washing course Yes. - Child safety function Yes. Installation process. Specify desired delivery date (check via KakaoTalk). Specify sink renovation date. Visit of renovation technician and renovation. Specify dishwasher installation date (check via KakaoTalk). Dishwasher installation. The total required period is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, renovation in the morning and installation in the afternoon are possible on the same day! Overall. If I had no plans to move at all, I think I would have chosen a higher model. However, . This model isn't functionally lacking, but rather because it's not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and is only for 12 people. For that price, I'm extremely satisfied with this large dishwasher with built-in features for a 6-person price. While some may disagree with the 3-tier model, this one's top basket can be raised to its maximum, and the bottom can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container, so I find it much more useful. The design of the control panel was a bit dated, but I hate it when the touchscreen doesn't work well with wet hands or rubber gloves. I also really like the push-button design of this model. I think my parents will find it much more convenient, too. When I personally looked into installing a sink, two places refused to do it because it would require reducing the cabinet space under the sink, as shown in the photo. The technician Samsung sent immediately approved the installation, and the cost of the non-standard cabinet was added to the cost of the countertop reinforcement, making it cheaper. They were so kind, and at the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I was grateful for the freedom. These days, all products are good at washing, but I used to use an SK product for 6 people. Personally, I think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent. If you use additional rinse, it will be very soft and fluffy, so keep that in mind. I recommend it and would like to repurchase. If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

(초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함(저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)● 제품명삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스● 사이즈12인용● 색상실버● 재질스테인리스● 디자인- 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용- 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X)- 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O)- 수저 바구니 O- 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스- 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)● 기능- 자동 문열림 O- 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X)- 예약 기능 O- 헹굼 추가 O- 살균 기능 O- 스팀 불림 O- 내부 세척코스 O-어린이 보호기능 O● 설치 과정구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼→ 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!● 총평이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다.하지만, 이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요.그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다.부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요.친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데, 개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요.문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나, 린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.● 추천 및 재구매 의사★★★★★↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

Sentence (English): Dishwasher is stylish and VERY quiet.
Comments (English): [ Excellent Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || Dishwasher is stylish and VERY quiet. Cleans great! Cycles are longer now-a-days than older dishwashers, but the dishes come out clean and dry when on the normal cycle. Dishes are a little damp on the express cycle. However. we were very hesitant to order a dishwasher from Costco based on negative reviews about Costco installation. We ordered both a stove and dishwasher at the same time. Delivery people would only be installing the stove as the dishwasher had to be installed by someone else. Items were to be delivered on Tuesday. On Monday night we received a call indicating when the appliances would be delivered. Then I received another call from the installer for the dishwasher indicating he would be picking up the dishwasher from the warehouse on Tuesday and would come to install it on Wednesday between 1pm and 4pm. Sure enough. the stove was delivered and installed on Tuesday. They were great. They indicated they did not have the dishwasher. On Wednesday the dishwasher installer showed up (within the indicated time with three minutes to spare) with the dishwasher and installed it and hauled away the old one within 30 minutes. The kitchen was built in 1972 and is old and dated. Original dishwasher was hard wired and the flooring was a mess. Turned off the circuit breaker and installer was able to install the dishwasher in the original space without any complaints. We did "uninstall" the original dishwasher as required on Costco's website. But all this to say. the install process for this dishwasher was flawless and the dishwasher is fabulous! Maybe the installation process is better in some states than others. but we were super impressed with the Costco installation process for both the stove and the dishwasher.

Sentence (English): A year after we installed it ourselves the dishwasher is still working fine.
Comments (English): [ After One Year Working Great ] || ---------------- || A year after we installed it ourselves the dishwasher is still working fine. The only problem we had was after installation when we got a code telling us we had a leak. That was due to the hose being loose (it has a plastic water inlet, so I was being careful not to overtighten it). Other than that, we've had no problems.It cleans well on powdered detergent (you don't need much) and is very quiet. We really like to top drawer and use it for cutting boards, spatulas, small Pyrex food storage bowls and lids - anything that fits. It's surprising how much room that frees up on the lower racks.The only weakness is the drying. We don't have an issue with that because we open it and pull the racks forward after it is done washing (we run on the non-drying cycle because it is quicker) and everything dries out pretty quickly with the exception of the top rack items. Not a big deal to us but I can see by the other reviews that it is to many.Other reviews also mention the control panel peeling off but so far, so good. I was concerned about that and hope we don't have any problems later.
